name: Holiday Park Zator
description: Located just 100 metres from Energylandia's entrance, this family resort offers comfortable cottages, an outdoor pool, spa and direct walking access to the park.

rooms.name: Standard Cottage
rooms.description: Comfortable modern cottage sleeping up to 4 with full kitchen, free WiFi and garden views.

rooms.name: Family Cottage
rooms.description: Spacious cottage sleeping up to 6 with two bedrooms, kitchen, terrace and pool access.

rooms.name: Spa Suite
rooms.description: Premium suite with access to the full-service spa, outdoor pool and sauna. Sleeps up to 4.

name: Western Camp Resort
description: A unique Wild West themed resort a short walk from Energylandia with cowboy-style accommodation, outdoor pool, Bonanza Restaurant and a free Golden Train shuttle to the park.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Western themed room sleeping up to 4 with free buffet breakfast and pool access.

rooms.name: Sheriff's House
rooms.description: A standalone western-style house sleeping up to 6, perfect for families. Pets welcome.

rooms.name: Houseboat
rooms.description: A unique floating houseboat accommodation with western decor sleeping up to 4. Pets welcome.

name: Fantazja Resort Zator
description: A cosy parkside retreat on Ul. Graniczna, officially listed by Energylandia as partner accommodation. Ideal for unwinding after a full day of thrills.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable room sleeping up to 4 with free WiFi and easy park access.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Larger family room sleeping up to 6 with separate children area and free parking.
